with the then-unfixed torch.topk tie handling, part of that spread may be run-to-run nondeterminism rather than placement (see 07_Q3O_MOE_EQUIVALENCE.json); the runs were not repeated, so the two effects are NOT separated

receipt_text_inaccuracy.says: fp32 compute with official bf16 rounding points
